title: Identification of biomarkers associated with programmed cell death in liver ischemia-reperfusion injury: insights from machine learning frameworks and molecular docking in multiple cohorts.
authors: Liu, Jifeng; Jin, Yeheng; Lv, Fengchen; Yang, Yao; Li, Junchen; Zhang, Yunshu; Zhong, Lei; Liu, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习筛选肝缺血再灌注损伤中程序性细胞死亡相关生物标志物并进行分子对接，虽涉及转录因子预测，但核心是疾病诊断标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Liver ischemia-reperfusion injury (LIRI) is a major reason for liver injury that occurs during surgical procedures such as hepatectomy and liver transplantation and is a major cause of graft dysfunction after transplantation. Programmed cell death (PCD) has been found to correlate with the degree of LIRI injury and plays an important role in the treatment of LIRI. We aim to comprehensively explore the expression patterns and mechanism of action of PCD-related genes in LIRI and to find novel molecular targets for early prevention and treatment of LIRI. METHODS: We first compared the expression profiles, immune profiles, and biological function profiles of LIRI and control samples. Then, the potential mechanisms of PCD-related differentially expressed genes in LIRI were explored by functional enrichment analysis. The hub genes for LIRI were further screened by applying multiple machine learning methods and Cytoscape. GSEA, GSVA, immune correlation analysis, transcription factor prediction, ceRNA network analysis, and single-cell analysis further revealed the mechanisms and regulatory network of the hub gene in LIRI. Finally, potential therapeutic agents for LIRI were explored based on the CMap database and molecular docking technology. RESULTS: Forty-seven differentially expressed genes associated with PCD were identified in LIRI, and functional enrichment analysis showed that they were involved in the regulation of the TNF signaling pathway as well as the regulation of hydrolase activity. By utilizing machine learning methods, 11 model genes were identified. ROC curves and confusion matrix from the six cohorts illustrate the superior diagnostic value of our model. MYC was identified as a hub PCD-related target in LIRI by Cytoscape. Finally, BMS-536924 and PF-431396 were identified as potential therapeutic agents for LIRI. CONCLUSION: This study comprehensively characterizes PCD in LIRI and identifies one core molecule, providing a new strategy for early prevention and treatment of LIRI.
abstract_zh: 引言：肝脏缺血再灌注损伤（LIRI）是肝切除术和肝移植等外科手术过程中发生肝损伤的主要原因，也是移植后移植物功能障碍的重要因素。程序性细胞死亡（PCD）已被发现与LIRI损伤程度相关，并在LIRI治疗中发挥重要作用。我们旨在全面探索PCD相关基因在LIRI中的表达模式和作用机制，并寻找用于LIRI早期预防和治疗的新型分子靶点。方法：我们首先比较了LIRI样本和对照样本的表达谱、免疫谱和生物学功能谱。然后，通过功能富集分析探讨了LIRI中PCD相关差异表达基因的潜在机制。通过应用多种机器学习方法和Cytoscape进一步筛选LIRI的核心基因。GSEA、GSVA、免疫相关性分析、转录因子预测、ceRNA网络分析和单细胞分析进一步揭示了LIRI中核心基因的机制和调控网络。最后，基于CMap数据库和分子对接技术探索了LIRI的潜在治疗药物。结果：在LIRI中鉴定出47个与PCD相关的差异表达基因，功能富集分析显示它们参与TNF信号通路的调控以及水解酶活性的调节。通过利用机器学习方法，鉴定出11个模型基因。来自六个队列的ROC曲线和混淆矩阵展示了我们模型的优越诊断价值。通过Cytoscape，MYC被确定为LIRI中PCD相关的核心靶点。最后，BMS-536924和PF-431396被确定为LIRI的潜在治疗药物。结论：本研究全面表征了LIRI中的PCD，并识别出一个核心分子，为LIRI的早期预防和治疗提供了新策略。
